verdict.rationale: Spline exposes several programmatic surfaces — a Code API/runtime API for web embeds, a Real-time API, webhooks, and code export to JS/React frameworks — plus an MCP server for agentic clients, which together let AI-native users drive it programmatically. However, there is no evidence of a single documented general-purpose public REST/GraphQL API with an OpenAPI spec (probe explicitly found 404s for openapi/swagger endpoints), so 'documented public API' is fragmented across runtime/webhook/MCP surfaces rather than one comprehensive API. missing for 10: a unified, versioned public API reference (e.g., OpenAPI spec) covering full CRUD over projects/scenes, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these APIs working outside vendor docs.
